It is strongest on English possessive and demonstrative determiners in any case: ' this' (max 2.1), ' your', ' their', ' our', ' his', ' its' (about 1.9-2.1), ' my', ' her', ' these', ' thy', 'This'/'The'/'Your' forms (1.3-1.6). It also fires on ' the'/'The' (about 1.4-1.5), ' those', ' each', ' every', ' any', ' some', ' whose', ' an', ' another' (0.5-1.2), and on foreign determiners such as ' cette', ' notre', ' votre', ' leur', ' la', ' los', 'その', 'この', '这'. It is inactive (below 0.25 of max) on ' that' (0), ' a', 'A'/' A', ' which', ' many', ' few', ' most', ' all', ' both', ' several', on subject and object pronouns (' he', ' you', ' I', ' him', ' them', ' me'; ' we', ' they' and ' it' sit just at the line, about 0.55-0.6), and on all nouns, verbs, prepositions, conjunctions and punctuation.
